verdict.rationale: Digits documents a dedicated developer sandbox: each developer gets their own resettable demo instance pre-loaded with realistic data, and OAuth with Development keys automatically selects the demo client. Testing therefore happens away from production ledgers, and the API page markets 'Full OpenAPI spec & sandbox — test freely'. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described, and evidence that the agent-facing MCP server (which signs in to the user's own account) can be pointed at the demo instance rather than live data.
